title: Phalloidin Immunofluorescence Staining
author: Dania Villarnovo

steps_raw.instruction: Phalloidin + DAPI Immunofluorescence Staining Protocol
-At desired time point, remove ~100 uL aliquot from each treatment well and place in small tube.
-Mix cells thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
-With a pipette, apply ~100 uL of cells from the tube onto the center of a slide and spread cells with the pipette tip. Allow slides to air dry.
-3% formaldehyde in 1x PBS: 4.1 mL of 36.5% stock + 45.9 mL of 1x PBS
-0.5% Triton X-100: 250 uL of Triton X-100 + 50 mL of 1x PBS
-2x Phalloidin conjugate working solution: 2 uL of 1000x Phalloidin + 1 mL of 1x PBS w/ 1% BSA (10 mg/mL)
-1 ug/mL DAPI in 1x PBS: 3 uL of 1 mg/mL stock + 3 mL of 1x PBS or 0.6 uL of 5 mg/mL stock + 3 mL of 1x PBS
Cell Fixation & Permeabilization
-Add 3% formaldehyde (methanol-free) in 1x PBS to top of each slide for 30 min.
-Rinse 2x with 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Add 0.5% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Rinse 2x with 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Add 200 uL of phalloidin per slide for 2 hrs.
-Rinse 2x with 1x PBS for 10 min.
-Add 200 uL of DAPI per slide for 10 min.
-Rinse 2x with 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Add a drop of Vectashield, coverslip, and apply nail polish to edges.
**Keep slides in dark during staining, imaging, and in storage.
Fascin-1/Alpha-tubulin + Phalloidin + DAPI Immnofluorescence Staining Protocol
-At desired time point, remove ~100 uL aliquot from each treatment well and place in small tube.
-Allow cells to settle to bottom of tube over ~1 hr.
-With a pipette, apply cells from the bottom of the tube onto the center of a slide and spread cells with the pipette tip. Allow slides to air dry.
-Fixative- 3% formaldehyde in 1x PBS: 4.1 mL of 36.5% stock + 45.9 mL of 1x PBS
-Permeabilizing solution- 0.5% Triton X-100: 250 uL of Triton X-100 + 50 mL of 1x PBS
-2x Phalloidin (Abcam Alexa-Fluor 488, 176753) conjugate working solution: 2 uL of 1000x Phalloidin + 1 mL of 1x PBS w/ 1% BSA (10 mg/mL)
-1.5 ug/mL DAPI (Thermo Scientific, 62247) in 1x PBS: 4.5 uL of 1 mg/mL stock + 3 mL of 1x PBS
-Blocking solution- 1% BSA in 1xPBS: 10 mg BSA + 1 mL of 1x PBS
-Mouse anti-fascin-1 primary antibody (Santa Cruz (55K-2), sc-21743) solution: 1:500 dilution
-Mouse anti-alpha-tubulin primary antibody (Sigma-Aldrich, T5168) solution: 1:500 dilution
-Goat anti-mouse secondary antibody (Abcam Alexa-Fluor 647, 150119) solution: 1:500 dilution
Cell Fixation, Permeabilization, and Blocking
-Add fixative to top of each slide for 30 min.
-Wash 1x with 1x PBS for 10 min.
-Add permeabilizing solution for 5 min.
-Wash 2x with 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Add blocking solution for 1 hr.
-Add 200 uL of primary antibody solution per slide for 1 hr.
-Wash 3x with 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Add 200 uL of secondary antibody solution per slide for 1 hr in dark.
-Wash 3x with 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Add 200 uL of phalloidin per slide for 2 hrs in dark.
-Rinse 2x with 1x PBS for 10 min.
-Add 200 uL of DAPI per slide for 10 min in dark.
-Rinse 2x with 1x PBS for 5 min.
-Add 2 drops of Vectashield mounting medium (Vector labs, H-1000), coverslip, and apply nail polish to edges.
**Keep slides in dark during staining, imaging, and in storage.
